items.message: The 'create branch via bundle' sub-case is inside the same pytest.raises block as the preceding absorb, so it may never execute.
The cleanup test asserts sorted record order contains both ids, but 'triage-412' sorts before 'run-new' — the assertion would pass even if the new real record were absent.
The 'known' set omits the fourth leaked id mentioned in the design comment ('review-security'), so the test would flag it as an unexpected fixture record.

test_gate_dogfood_1_the_learning_loop_has_measured_here asserts all blocked improve records have a reason, but the 'at least one improve run exists' assertion is the meaningful one; the all() over a filtered subset adds no signal if the subset is empty.
